{{RV|type=command

|game1= arma3
|version1= 2.08

|arg= local

|eff= global

|gr1= PhysX

|descr= Disables autobrake, which is engaged when vehicle is stationary and stops wheels from rotating freely when vehicle is pushed.

|s1= transport [[disableBrakes]] disable

|p1= transport: [[Object]] - PhysX car or tank

|p2= disable: [[Boolean]] - [[true]] to disable autobrake. The autobrake is re-enabled if the driver uses brakes

|r1= [[Nothing]]

|x1= <sqf>myCar disableBrakes true;</sqf>

|seealso= [[brakesDisabled]] [[awake]] [[isAwake]] [[addTorque]] [[addForce]] [[vectorModelToWorld]] [[vectorModelToWorldVisual]] [[selectionPosition]] [[setVelocityTransformation]] [[setVelocityModelSpace]]
